source.title: Small Business Administration section (Table-5 cap-fit unit, page 20). Full 9-column outlays model. Self-contained: no cell overlaps another unit's table. Family pattern: plans/treasury-mts-2026-05-outlays-table5.md.
source.period: May FY2026 (This Month = May 2026; Current FYTD = Oct 2025 - May 2026; Prior FYTD = Oct 2024 - May 2025)

unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Table 5 legend (p. 23): '......' = 'No Transactions' (omitted); '(**)' = 'Less than absolute value of $500,000' -- omitted (Business Loans This-Month Gross/Applicable/Outlays and Current/Prior Applicable; Disaster Loans all three Applicable cells). Values as printed, thousands separators stripped, negatives as leading '-'. Full visual render and cid-decoded text-layer cross-check completed for page 20. All nine columns roll up; the Other line and section total add six net identities. Seven relations require tol 1 under the printed rounding note, with omitted sub-$0.5 cells contributing to several one-unit printed gaps.

relations.why: Table 5 footnote (p. 23) prints: "Note: Details may not add to totals due to rounding." Components are independently rounded to $ millions; the printed target differs from the exact sum of its printed components by the stated tolerance. Omitted (**) cells ('Less than absolute value of $500,000', per the legend) may each contribute less than 0.5.
